solutions.title: Two-dimensional DP
solutions.strategy: Fill a grid where each cell equals paths from above plus paths from the left.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every grid cell is computed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The full DP grid stores every cell count.

solutions.title: One-dimensional DP
solutions.strategy: Compress the DP grid to one row because each state only needs the current left value and previous-row value.

timeComplexity.explanation: The nested loops still visit every logical cell.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only one row of n path counts is stored.
